data.define: Used to say you are very hungry. It's an exaggeration.

misuse.text: Don't say 'I'm starving' to people facing real hunger.
misuse.why: It's an exaggeration and can sound insensitive.

publish.title: What does "I'm starving" mean?
publish.value: I'm starving = I'm really, really hungry. Example: "I'm starving! What's for dinner?" (casual English).
